title: Run.GatePassed
description: The payload of a pass at a worktree run's gate (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.GatePassed): an approver couldn't act, so the gate went to the next approver in the run's list. Only troupe passes, when the run's diff doesn't apply cleanly to the working tree; nothing was applied. At most one, after the run's end and before any cue.

lineage.description: Its lineage names the run's performance (spec: lineage, "Lineage names an event's performance").

to.description: The approver the gate went to next.

reason.description: Why it couldn't act: conflict, the diff doesn't apply cleanly to the working tree. A closed set.

files.description: The files whose part of the diff doesn't apply to the working tree, relative to the theatre.
